claims.statement: LoopService is a facade that keeps the loop subsystem's external method surface stable while delegating substantive work to focused sub-services constructed in its constructor: LoopLifecycleService (continue/retry/split), LoopWorkerExecutorService (maker/checker execution and worker-approval decisions), LoopVerificationService (completion gates), LoopDiscoveryService (finding scanners), LoopBudgetService (budgets/escalation/cost), WorktreeManager (git worktrees), WorkerLeaseRepo (worker_leases persistence and lineage), LoopEventService (loop_events), LoopRunQueryService/LoopRunMutationService (loop_runs read/write), LoopRecoveryService (crash recovery), RuntimeCommandService (runtime contracts/process spawning), and LoopPersistenceService (LOOP_STATE.md, diffs, evidence dirs). The continueLoopRun/splitLoopFinding/retryLoopRun entrypoints delegate to this.lifecycle (loop-service.ts L724-732), verifyLoopRun/certifyLoopRun to this.verification, decideWorkerApproval to this.workerExecutor, and awaitWorkerExecution polls the lease's engine task until terminal.

The canonical loop catalog (LOOP_CATALOG in packages/shared/src/loop-catalog.ts) defines seven loops, all in mode 'closed'; each is expanded into a full LoopContract in loop-service.ts with risk_class, trigger, context_sources, actions_allowed, actions_forbidden, verification, state, escalation, and stop_conditions fields, and an unknown loop_name fails closed with LOOP_NAME_UNSUPPORTED.

LoopService.startLoop persists the resolved contract into loop_runs.metadata.contract so the run's rules survive restarts, initializes gates (read_only_discovery pass, no_automatic_merge pass, maker_checker_separation/tests skipped, security_checker_verdict skipped for high/critical contracts), and lands the run at 'planning' when findings exist or 'completed' with outcome no_change_required when none exist.

continueLoopRun prepares, per assigned finding, one maker lease (with a worktree and branch) plus a linked manual checker lease (metadata.maker_lease_id), and additionally a security_checker lease when isHighRiskRun holds (run or goal risk_class high/critical, security-category finding, or auth/secret/policy-sounding finding content); it enforces operator pause, escalation, wall/token budgets, failed-gate and split-parent guards, and the per-run maker worker budget (default 5, cap 100).

retryLoopRun counts used retries against a max_retries budget (goal > request > lease > default 1, hard cap 10) by following retry_root_maker_lease_id, prepares a fresh maker/checker pair on a -r<attempt> branch and worktree, and marks the prior maker lease with superseded_by_maker_lease_id rather than rewriting it.

The worker_leases table has a CHECK constraint admitting six roles (planner, maker, checker, security_checker, memory_curator, governance_guard) and five statuses (prepared, running, completed, failed, cancelled), and a later migration adds nested-spawn lineage columns parent_lease_id, spawn_tree_id, depth, spawned_by_agent_id, and capability_id so spawn-tree ancestry stays durable and queryable.

WorkerLeaseRepo.updateStatus refuses to persist a 'failed' lease without a failure reason, deriving failure_reason from execution_denied_reason, runtime contract failure, timeout, or exit status before defaulting to 'unspecified: caller supplied no reason'.

WorktreeManager.createWorktree creates worker worktrees on agent/loop/<runId>-<findingId> branches under LOOP_WORKTREE_ROOT (default .djimitflo-loop-worktrees beside the repo), retries up to 3 times on git lock contention (failing as WORKTREE_CREATE_FAILED), and symlinks the root and per-workspace node_modules directories into the worktree unless linkDependencies is disabled.

applySourceWorkingTreeDiff snapshots the source working tree into the worker worktree by applying the tracked binary diff and copying untracked files, excluding .git and node_modules, skipping any path containing '..', and verifying that resolved source and target paths stay inside the repository and worktree roots respectively (path-traversal guards); the snapshot is committed in-worktree with an explicit djimitflo git identity.
pruneOrphanedWorktrees removes worktree directories older than LOOP_WORKTREE_MAX_AGE_HOURS (default 24h) unless their worker lease is still prepared or running.

Input-side path safety complements worktree guards: resolveRepositoryPath allowlists repository roots via OKF_ALLOWED_ROOTS, createTargetFinding rejects absolute or escaping target file paths via realpath prefix checks, and assertWithinWorktreeRoot refuses to spawn a runtime whose cwd is outside the configured worktree roots (RUNTIME_CWD_OUTSIDE_WORKTREE).

executeMaker marks a prepared maker lease running, fails it as RUNTIME_CONTRACT_DRIFTED when the runtime contract is unavailable or drifted, evaluates per-execution gates (maker_runtime_exit_zero, diff_under_threshold, token_budget, runtime_warning_gate, no_automatic_merge), restores package-lock.json when it changed without a package.json change, and moves the run to 'verifying' or 'blocked' with gates recorded.

executeChecker requires a completed maker linked by metadata.maker_lease_id, cuts the checker worktree from the maker's worktree with dependency linking disabled, rejects any checker worktree whose realpath equals another lease's worktree (CHECKER_WORKTREE_NOT_INDEPENDENT), and fails the <role>_read_only_contract gate if the checker worktree is dirty after execution.

Real (non-mock) runtimes dispatch through ExecutionEngine: executeViaEngine inserts a tasks row tagged loop-worker with a stable auto-registered agent identity per runtime+role name, reuses prior execution results, and surfaces governance outcomes as LOOP_WORKER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED or LOOP_WORKER_EXECUTION_DENIED while resetting the lease to prepared/failed.

verifyLoopRun evaluates eleven gates (run_not_cancelled, maker_completion, maker_checker_separation, worktree_isolation, assignment_file_present, diff_threshold_all_makers, checker_verdict, tests_lint_typecheck, security_checker_verdict (high-risk only), auto_approved_scope (J5 one-file scope), no_automatic_merge) over non-superseded makers and their linked reviewers, deriving run status ready_for_human_merge/blocked/verifying and recording block_reason=gate_failed with failed-gate evidence on run metadata; a maker_completion failure does not block while makers are still prepared/running (waitingForMakers), and cancelled/completed runs keep their status.

hasAcceptedReviewEvidence treats 'accepted' as strict proof: manual-runtime checkers need a manual_review_attestation with reviewer and reason, while runtime checkers need exit_status 0, no timeout or cancellation, runtime_verdict accepted, read_only_contract_passed true, runtime_adapter matching the lease runtime, an available ok runtime contract, and an existing stdout log.

completeLoopRun re-runs verification and refuses completion with HIGH_RISK_SECURITY_CHECK_REQUIRED, LOOP_COMPLETION_BLOCKED:<gate>, LOOP_COMPLETION_LEASES_INCOMPLETE, or LOOP_HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; the /runs/:id/complete route requires the approve:task permission and only passes a human_approval_ref of the form operator:<actor> when both an authenticated actor and a requested ref exist, settling the linked goal and self_improvement record on success.

LoopBudgetService derives limits from the run's goal budget with defaults and hard caps: max_maker_workers default 5 cap 100, max_retries default 1 cap 10, max_failure_count default 3 cap 20; exceeding the failure threshold (failed makers plus checker/security verdicts of needs_revision, rejected, or insufficient_evidence) escalates the run and emits a loop_escalated event, while assertWallClockBudgetAvailable blocks the run and emits loop_budget_exhausted on wall-clock exhaustion.

evaluateTokenBudget skips the token_budget gate when no budget is configured or the runtime reported no usage (never estimated); otherwise it fails the gate when per-worker tokens exceed max_tokens_per_worker or run totals exceed max_tokens, and flags efficiencyExceeded when tokens per diff line exceed max_tokens_per_diff_line. extractRuntimeUsage first aggregates opencode per-step step_finish events (part.tokens), then falls back to scanning stdout JSON lines for a usage/token_usage object with normalized aliases.

Dollar cost is priced per runtime via a PRICE_PER_MTOK table (codex $2/Mtok, opencode $0.5, claude $3, gemini $1, pi/editor/mock $0); computeEfficiencyMetric reports verified artifacts per dollar from completed maker leases and recorded runtime usage, and allocateDollarBudget ranks findings by competence-per-p50-dollar before greedily allocating a budget.

Process-level concurrency is bounded by the global runtimeConcurrencySemaphore (RUNTIME_MAX_CONCURRENCY, default 4, read fresh on each acquire), while LoopBudgetService.adjustConcurrency computes an additive-increase/decrease-to-floor-of-1 dynamic limit over RUNTIME_MAX_CONCURRENCY and publishes aimd_state on the swarm event bus for the loop daemon's goal scheduling.

On server bootstrap, LoopRecoveryService.recoverInterruptedRuns idempotently fails 'running' leases absent from the in-memory RuntimeLeaseRegistry (failed_reason=server_restart) and marks active runs interrupted unless they are planning or awaiting human approval; LoopService.recoverInterruptedRuns additionally prunes orphaned worktrees, and resumeInterruptedRun requeues unfinished findings up to maxResumeAttempts (default 3) before terminally failing the run (boundedFail).

prepareNestedLease materializes a nested-spawn child lease on an agent/nested/<tree>/d<depth>-<id> branch, writes a Nested Spawn Control block with scoped-token curl instructions when the child may self-spawn, records parent_lease_id/spawn_tree_id/depth lineage in worker_leases, and mints the spawn token scoped to (lease.id, spawn_tree_id) that lives only in the child's process env, while the spawned child env merges the static runtime env allowlist so PATH/HOME are preserved.

LoopEventService appends every run transition to the loop_events table and transparently compresses event metadata larger than 500 characters via ContextCompressionService when the compression ratio is beneficial.

LoopService.awaitWorkerExecution(leaseId) bridges the asynchronous gap after a worker approval: it polls the lease's metadata.execution_task_id -> tasks.status every pollMs (default 5000) until the status leaves the non-terminal set (running/queued/awaiting_approval/pending) or a 660 s deadline (default timeoutMs 660_000) passes, returning the terminal status or null when the lease/task is absent. This fixes a 2026-09-25 prod race in which an auto-approved evolve sibling was read back and scored as a loss while still running.

When executeViaEngine finds an existing engine task on the lease's metadata.execution_task_id, it refuses to re-run: a running/queued task resets the lease to prepared and throws LOOP_WORKER_EXECUTION_IN_PROGRESS (mapped to HTTP 409), and an awaiting_approval task throws LOOP_WORKER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, so the caller must wait for an approval decision before awaiting completion with awaitWorkerExecution and re-executing to read the stored result.

decideWorkerApproval is the facade entrypoint that submits a worker approval decision to the ExecutionEngine via workerExecutor.decideApproval, which delegates to ExecutionEngine.handleApprovalDecision; both the loop-daemon auto-approve-sibling path and the evolution-gym maker path call awaitWorkerExecution after the decision to wait for the approved execution before reading the outcome.
